description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967) with 4x OUTPUT-SCATTER SPARSITY on all 4 LUT modules. Each table now writes target/4 values scattered (balanced) into the full target-wide output (sparse_scatter_n_outputs=target, n_outputs=target/4), so each output dim is assembled from ~tph/4 tables instead of all tph. Output dims unchanged (q/k/v split, E/D streams identical), but LUT params ~74.7M->18.7M and per-token LUT output-write bandwidth drop 4x. Q: how much bpb do we lose for 4x cheaper/sparser LUTs? Optimizer/training identical to exp453. Saves checkpoint.
